source.notes: Gelson's Westlake Village (7 SCAN receipts; stylescan on the 3 whose recorded raw keys live in raw-image-bucket-c779c32). Body is single-width thermal. Department headers (GROCERY/PRODUCE/REG DELI/BAKERY/WINE) measure bold (stroke_rel med 1.194). The dashed underline under those headers is a below-box dot-matrix rule that stylescan's box-interior detector misses (July 2026 fleet: 13/13 underlined) -- kept underline true. The Gelson's wordmark is a printed script logo (logo band), not bold text; store_header stroke_rel 1.161 is that graphic. Payment/summary/footer/BALANCE DUE measure body-normal (total_line stroke_rel 1.112 is under the 1.12 bold cut).
